weight_generation: default_rng(model_seed); Wi normal(H,d)*sqrt(2/d), Wh normal(H,H)*sqrt(2/H), Wo normal(H,H)*sqrt(1/H), in that order
report: Per-cell output-mean variance-normalised squared error, block variation,1/N reference-noise floor, component/call counts and CPU. Finite diagnostic, no K>2/asymptotic/competitive-cost or trained-ladder claim.
failure_policy: Save every completed cell and failure. Four per-H processes capped110CPU, one thread2GB; no tuning/enlargement based on results.
